text: {"reply":"I'm glad to help with the lease return, but I can't share or check details on your dad's account with you, because only the account holder can access them. He can contact us directly. I'm also passing this to a person, who will check whether you're authorised to act for him and can help with the drop-off and inspection on 2026-11-26. I'm sorry for the mix-up earlier: please don't send his phone number or VIN in the chat.\n\nIn general, a lease return starts with a pre-return inspection. The inspector notes any wear beyond normal use, and any charge is explained in the inspection report before payment.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"A person who says they are the son or daughter of the lease holder asked to handle the lease-return drop-off and pre-return inspection on 2026-11-26, because the account holder can no longer drive.
